description: The Snakehead is aptly named, not only for its shape, but for the twin retractable ventral-mounted disruptor cannons that emerge like venomous fangs to strike fear into any enemy bold enough to cross its path. Featuring subthrusters and a cloaking device that can be reversed to project a false decoy of the ship, the Snakehead is the epitome of Romulan ingenuity. It was built for the hunt, and the Order of Ganmadan intends to put it to good use.
